meta.name: cortex-eval
meta.description: Evaluate model performance — check for accuracy drops, data drift, and error patterns. Use when asked about "model accuracy dropped", "evaluate the model", "check for drift", or "model performance".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估模型性能，监控准确率下降和数据漂移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要持续监控和评估机器学习模型。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate model performance, monitor accuracy drops and data drift
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to continuously monitor and evaluate machine learning models.

howto.what: 当用户询问模型表现时，Claude会执行模型评估流程：先进行静态代码分析，再检测ML环境，然后比较当前指标与基线，分析特征/预测分布漂移和错误模式，最后识别根本原因并推荐修复方案，生成评估报告。
howto.when: 当用户说出“model accuracy dropped”、“evaluate the model”、“check for drift”等关键词，或要求检查模型性能时触发。

say.text: 评估一下当前模型的性能。
say.note: Claude会执行完整评估流程并输出报告。

say.text: 检查模型准确率是否下降了。
say.note: Claude会比较当前指标与基线并给出差异。

say.text: 分析一下数据漂移情况。
say.note: Claude会检查特征分布漂移和预测分布变化。

howto.what_en: When asked about model performance, Claude runs an evaluation pipeline: static analysis, ML environment detection, metric comparison with baseline, feature/prediction drift analysis, error pattern analysis, root cause identification, and fix recommendations. Outputs a report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user mentions keywords like "model accuracy dropped", "evaluate the model", "check for drift", or asks about model performance.

say_en.note: Claude runs the full evaluation and outputs a report.
Claude compares current metrics to baseline.
Claude checks feature and prediction distribution changes.
